description_en: Creates a quota template. After the management account creates a quota template, the template automatically submits quota increase applications for new members added to the resource directory. Existing members remain unaffected. You can use a quota template to apply for increases to multiple quota items at a time, improving the efficiency and automation of quota management across the organization. Only the management account of a resource directory can create a quota template
description_zh: 管理账号创建配额模板后，如果资源目录新增成员，则配额模板自动为新增的成员提交配额提升申请，已有成员无变化。通过配额模板，您一次可以申请提升多个配额项，提升整个组织的配额管理效率和自动化水平。只有资源目录的管理员账号可创建配额模版
kebab_example: aliyun quotas create-template-quota-item --product-code ecs --quota-action-code q_security-groups --desire-value 804.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTemplateQuotaItem

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the abbreviation of a cloud service, see `ProductCode` in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The quota ID.

For information about how to obtain the quota ID of a cloud service, see `QuotaActionCode` in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html
parameters.help_zh:
配额ID。

关于如何获取云产品的配额ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html中的0
parameters.name: quota_action_code

parameters.help_en:
The requested quota value.

Set the requested quota value based on the `TotalUsage` (quota usage) and `ApplicableRange` (applicable range for the quota item) of the target quota in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html.
Quota applications are reviewed by the technical support team of each cloud service. To increase the approval rate, specify a reasonable requested value and provide a detailed reason when you apply for a quota increase
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请的值。

根据https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440554.html中目标配额的0（配额用量）和1（配额项可申请范围）来设置配额申请值。
配额申请由各云产品的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由
parameters.name: desire_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to send a notification for the quota application result. Valid values:
0 (default): No.
3: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
配额申请结果是否发送通知。取值：
0（默认值）：否。
3：是
parameters.name: notice_type

fields.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

The value range of N depends on the number of dimensions supported by the cloud service.
If `ProductCode` is `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and the value of the quota dimension
fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Key。

N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the quota dimension.

The value range of N depends on the number of dimensions supported by the cloud service.
If `ProductCode` is `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and the value of the quota dimension
fields.help_zh:

当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置

parameters.help_en:
The UTC time when the quota takes effect.
This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel). 

An empty value indicates that the quota takes effect immediately
parameters.help_zh:

该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。

parameters.help_en:
The UTC time when the quota expires.
This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel). 

An empty value indicates that no UTC expiration time is specified
parameters.help_zh:

数据为空表示未设定UTC失效时间
